# Differential Code Coverage Ratchet (>= 90%)

Differential coverage enforcement: requiring >= 90% branch and statement coverage on newly added or modified lines in Git pull requests.

## Invariants
- MINIMUM_90_PERCENT_COVERAGE_ON_NEW_DIFF
- NEVER_ALLOW_COVERAGE_METRIC_TO_REGRESS
- EXCLUDE_GENERATED_CODE_FROM_COVERAGE
